description: Scrape public Facebook business page recommendations and reviews by page URL, numeric Page ID, or username. Returns review rows plus one page-summary row per page.

cookies.description: Optional Facebook cookies exported from a logged-in browser. They are not required and do not increase how many reviews Facebook serves per request; the actor returns real reviews without them.
cookies.title: Optional Facebook Cookies

dateFrom.description: Only return reviews posted on or after this date. Reviews are newest-first, so collection stops when it passes this date.
dateFrom.title: Date From (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: Only return reviews posted on or before this date.
dateTo.title: Date To (YYYY-MM-DD)

failOnEmpty.description: Mark the run as failed when no review rows are returned. Monitor-mode runs that legitimately have no new reviews never fail.
failOnEmpty.title: Fail When Nothing Is Found

includePageSummary.description: Emit one recordType=page row per page with the recommendation percentage, total review count, followers, and talking-about count. This adds no extra requests.
includePageSummary.title: Include Page Summary Row

includeReplies.description: Include the visible top comments and business owner replies inside each review row. When disabled, commentCount is still returned.
includeReplies.title: Include Comments and Owner Replies

keyword.description: Only return reviews whose text contains this word or phrase (case-insensitive).
keyword.title: Keyword Filter

maxItems.description: Maximum number of review rows to return across all pages (1-2000). Facebook returns roughly 2-3 reviews per request (about 2.7 on average) even when a larger count is requested, so 100 reviews needs about 35-40 requests.
maxItems.title: Max Reviews

maxPerPage.description: Optional cap per Facebook page for multi-page runs. Leave empty to share the global Max Reviews cap across pages.
maxPerPage.title: Max Reviews Per Page

maxRuntimeSecs.description: Stop collecting after this many seconds and return what has been collected so far.
maxRuntimeSecs.title: Run Time Budget (seconds)

onlyNew.description: Return only reviews not seen in the saved state for this page. The state is stored in a named key-value store that persists across runs, so scheduled runs can monitor for new reviews.
onlyNew.title: Only New Reviews (Monitor Mode)

pageIds.description: Numeric Facebook Page IDs (e.g. 100064458773195) or page usernames (e.g. mcdonalds). Use this when you do not have a full URL.
pageIds.title: Facebook Page IDs or Usernames

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave empty to let the actor choose automatically: it tries a direct connection first and only escalates through Apify Proxy if Facebook blocks the request. Change this only if you need a specific proxy setup.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

recommendation.description: Only return reviews with the selected recommendation status. Facebook uses binary Recommended / Not Recommended, not star ratings.
recommendation.title: Recommendation Filter

requestDelayMs.description: Pause between review requests. 500-800 ms is a polite pace and keeps long runs stable.
requestDelayMs.title: Delay Between Requests (ms)

startUrls.description: Facebook business page URLs or /reviews URLs (e.g. https://www.facebook.com/mcdonalds/reviews). /reviews is added automatically when missing. Invalid or dead page URLs fail fast instead of being guessed.

url.description: Facebook business Page URL or /reviews URL.
url.title: Page URL

startUrls.title: Facebook Page URLs

stateKey.description: Optional prefix for the key-value store key used by monitor mode. Each page's state is stored separately. Leave empty to use the page ID.
stateKey.title: Monitor State Key

title: Facebook Business Page Review Scraper Input
